repaired_contracts.proof: Direct async open awaits canonical compute context acquisition. Public textures awaits bake; bake submits successfully before sequential awaited Buffer reads. No pollster blocking remains in those library operations. ValidatedMetal borrow, Cut and local buffers stay alive across awaits; optional depth read still follows depth_uv, and final sealed MetalTextures publication follows all required successful reads.

Static async_lock::OnceCell stores Result<MetalGpu,GpuInitializationError>; initializer awaits armor_gpu_async on the actual shared ArmorGpu context/cache. async-lock3.4.2 get_or_init wraps the returned inner Result as successful stored T, so a completed failure is retained. Cancellation before an initializer finishes leaves no completed outcome; it does not erase/retry a recorded failure. Source, context and error identity remain owned and immutable.

ShellTextures::armor awaits acquisition and bake before PNG creation. MetalImages blocks at its explicit offline native UI boundary and publishes assets only after complete GPU packet success. CLI catalog/equipment exporters block on the entire async call at existing synchronous native export boundaries, then push material records. The equipment Option map finishes the borrowed local metal future before leaving its closure. No old primitive/compatibility overload or source-error stringification added.

Chain read checks exact actual device, takes canonical checked logical prefix, awaits Buffer read and decodes padded rows using retained immutable positive fixed layout. GpuScalpTexture aggregate returns only after both awaited chains. longest handles producing submit before awaiting its local output; its native GroomedHair caller blocks at its explicitly documented native studio/export entry. Existing native render fixture likewise blocks only at fixture boundary.

Final boundary batch submit now propagates failure before GpuScalp construction. Prior metadata reads and storage/launch/trim source are unchanged by this delta. This proves host submission handling, not GPU completion, transaction rollback or later device health.

Unsound distance to first triangle corner prune removed. Every triangle now reaches the same existing closest_on_triangle routine; ascending traversal, max distance, d<=best tie replacement, barycentric helper, marker and normal/UV interpolation are unchanged. A near point on a coarse triangle can no longer be skipped solely because its first vertex is farther than best+0.03. Complete native kernel source read; no numerical runtime/performance pass claimed.
